resetbin = script.Parent

function onButton1Down(mouse)
	local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
		if player == nil then return end
		player.Character.Humanoid.Health = player.Character.Humanoid.Health - 25
		wait(1)
		player.Character.Humanoid.Health = player.Character.Humanoid.Health - 25
		wait(1)
		player.Character.Head.Transparency = 0.3
		wait(1)
		player.Character.Head.Transparency = 0.5
		wait(1)
		player.Character.Humanoid.Health = player.Character.Humanoid.Health - 45
		wait(1)
		player.Character.Head.Transparency = 0
		player.Character.Head.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Bright red")
		wait(5)
		player.Character.Humanoid.Health = 0
end

function onSelected(mouse)
	mouse.Icon = "rbxasset://textures\\ArrowCursor.png"
	mouse.Button1Down:connect(function() onButton1Down(mouse) end)
end

resetbin.Selected:connect(onSelected)
local type = "Cash" --Put the name of the currency here! eg. Money, or Cash

local bin = script.Parent
local donate = 0
local h = Instance.new("Hint")

function onButton1Down(mouse)
	local hit = mouse.Target
	if hit == nil then return end
	if hit.Parent:findFirstChild("Humanoid") ~= nil then
		local n = hit.Parent.Name
		local player = game.Players:findFirstChild(n) 
		if player == nil then return end 
		local cash = player.leaderstats:findFirstChild(type)
		local lplayer = game.Players.LocalPlayer
		local lcash = lplayer.leaderstats:findFirstChild(type)
		if lcash.Value >= donate then 
			lcash.Value = lcash.Value - donate 
			cash.Value = cash.Value + donate 
		end 
	end
end

function onDeselected(mouse)
	h:remove()
end 

function onKeyDown(key)
	if key ~= nil then 
		key = key:lower()
		if key == "g" then 
			donate = 25 
			h.Text = "Donating 25 " .. type
		end 
		if key == "h" then 
			donate = 50
			h.Text = "Donating 50 " .. type
		end 
		if key == "j" then 
			donate = 100
			h.Text = "Donating 100 " .. type
		end 
		if key == "k" then 
			donate = 1000
			h.Text = "Donating 1000 " .. type
		end 
	end 
end 

function onSelected(mouse)
	mess = game.Players.LocalPlayer:findFirstChild("Message")
	if mess ~= nil and mess.className == "Hint" then 
		mess:remove()
	end 
	mouse.Icon = "rbxasset://textures\\GunCursor.png"
	h.Parent = game.Players.LocalPlayer
	h.Text = "Press 'g' to donate 25, press 'h' to donate 50, press 'j' to donate 100 or press 'k' to donate 1000."
	mouse.Button1Down:connect(function() onButton1Down(mouse) end)
	mouse.KeyDown:connect(onKeyDown)
end

bin.Selected:connect(onSelected)
bin.Deselected:connect(onDeselected)

local ting = 0 --debouncer
owner = script.Parent.Parent.Parent.OwnerName --This is the thing that holds the owners name
function onTouched(hit) -- When someone hits this door do the following.
	if ting == 0 then --debounce check
	ting = 1 --activate debounce
	local check = hit.Parent:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") --Find the human that touched the button
		if check ~= nil then --If a human is found, then do the following.
			local thisplr = game.Players:findFirstChild(hit.Parent.Name) -- Checks humans name.
			if (thisplr~=nil) then -- If humans name is found, then do the  following.
				local ownstyc = thisplr:findFirstChild("Tycoon") -- Checks player to see if he has the Tycoon value.
				if (ownstyc~=nil) then -- If the tycoon value is found on the player, do the following.
					if ownstyc.Value == 0 then -- If the tycoon value is 0 then do the following.
						ownstyc.Value = 1  -- Make the tycoon value 1.
						owner.Value = thisplr.Name -- Player's value is now the Owner's value.
						local message = Instance.new("Message") -- Types a message to the player.
						message.Text = "You Now own a Tycoon" -- Message...
						message.Parent = thisplr -- Makes sure that the message goes to the player.
						wait(3) -- Wait 3 seconds.
						message:remove() -- Remove message.
						script.Parent.Parent:remove() -- Removes door.
					elseif ownstyc.Value == 1 then -- If the players Tycoon Value is 1.
						local message = Instance.new("Message") -- Types a message to the player.
						message.Text = "You Already own a Tycoon" -- Message...
						message.Parent = thisplr -- Makes sure the message goes to the player.
						wait(3) -- Wait 3 seconds.
						message:remove() -- Remove message.
					end -- End process.
				end -- End process.
			end -- End process.
		end -- End process.
	ting = 0 --remove debounce
	end -- End process.
end -- End process.

script.Parent.Touched:connect(onTouched) --Start listening for button-touchers.
function onTouched(part) 
	local h = part.Parent:findFirstChild("Humanoid") 
	if (h~=nil) then
		local owner = script.Parent.Parent.Parent.OwnerName
		if h.Parent.Name == owner.Value then 
			local thisplr = game.Players:findFirstChild(h.Parent.Name) 
			if (thisplr~=nil) then 
				local stats = thisplr:findFirstChild("leaderstats") 
				if (stats~=nil) then 
					local score = stats:findFirstChild("Cash") 
					if (score~=nil) then 
						score.Value = score.Value + script.Parent.Parent.Money.Value 
						script.Parent.Parent.Money.Value = 0
					end 
				end 
			end 
		end 
	end 
end

	ting = 0 --remove debounce

local ting = 0 --debouncer
owner = script.Parent.Parent.Parent.OwnerName --This is the thing that holds the owners name
function onTouched(hit) -- When someone hits this door do the following.
	if ting == 0 then --debounce check
	ting = 1 --activate debounce
	local check = hit.Parent:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") --Find the human that touched the button
		if check ~= nil then --If a human is found, then do the following.
			local thisplr = game.Players:findFirstChild(hit.Parent.Name) -- Checks humans name.
			if (thisplr~=nil) then -- If humans name is found, then do the  following.
				local ownstyc = thisplr:findFirstChild("Tycoon") -- Checks player to see if he has the Tycoon value.
				if (ownstyc~=nil) then -- If the tycoon value is found on the player, do the following.
					if ownstyc.Value == 0 then -- If the tycoon value is 0 then do the following.
						ownstyc.Value = 1  -- Make the tycoon value 1.
						owner.Value = thisplr.Name -- Player's value is now the Owner's value.
						local message = Instance.new("Message") -- Types a message to the player.
						message.Text = "You Now own a Tycoon" -- Message...
						message.Parent = thisplr -- Makes sure that the message goes to the player.
						wait(3) -- Wait 3 seconds.
						message:remove() -- Remove message.
						script.Parent.Parent:remove() -- Removes door.
					elseif ownstyc.Value == 1 then -- If the players Tycoon Value is 1.
						local message = Instance.new("Message") -- Types a message to the player.
						message.Text = "You Already own a Tycoon" -- Message...
						message.Parent = thisplr -- Makes sure the message goes to the player.
						wait(3) -- Wait 3 seconds.
						message:remove() -- Remove message.
					end -- End process.
				end -- End process.
			end -- End process.
		end -- End process.
	ting = 0 --remove debounce
	end -- End process.
end -- End process.

script.Parent.Touched:connect(onTouched) --Start listening for button-touchers.
function onTouched(part) 
	local h = part.Parent:findFirstChild("Humanoid") 
	if (h~=nil) then
		local owner = script.Parent.Parent.Parent.OwnerName
		if h.Parent.Name == owner.Value then 
			local thisplr = game.Players:findFirstChild(h.Parent.Name) 
			if (thisplr~=nil) then 
				local stats = thisplr:findFirstChild("leaderstats") 
				if (stats~=nil) then 
					local score = stats:findFirstChild("Cash") 
					if (score~=nil) then 
						score.Value = score.Value + script.Parent.Parent.Money.Value 
						script.Parent.Parent.Money.Value = 0
					end 
				end 
			end 
		end 
	end 
end

	end

function onTouched(hit) -- When someone hits this door do the following.
	if ting == 0 then --debounce check
	ting = 1 --activate debounce
	local check = hit.Parent:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") --Find the human that touched the button
		if check ~= nil then --If a human is found, then do the following.
			local thisplr = game.Players:findFirstChild(hit.Parent.Name) -- Checks humans name.
			if (thisplr~=nil) then -- If humans name is found, then do the  following.
				local ownstyc = thisplr:findFirstChild("Tycoon") -- Checks player to see if he has the Tycoon value.
				if (ownstyc~=nil) then -- If the tycoon value is found on the player, do the following.
					if ownstyc.Value == 0 then -- If the tycoon value is 0 then do the following.
						ownstyc.Value = 1  -- Make the tycoon value 1.
						owner.Value = thisplr.Name -- Player's value is now the Owner's value.
						local message = Instance.new("Message") -- Types a message to the player.
						message.Text = "You Now own a Tycoon" -- Message...
						message.Parent = thisplr -- Makes sure that the message goes to the player.
						wait(3) -- Wait 3 seconds.
						message:remove() -- Remove message.
						script.Parent.Parent:remove() -- Removes door.
					elseif ownstyc.Value == 1 then -- If the players Tycoon Value is 1.
						local message = Instance.new("Message") -- Types a message to the player.
						message.Text = "You Already own a Tycoon" -- Message...
						message.Parent = thisplr -- Makes sure the message goes to the player.
						wait(3) -- Wait 3 seconds.
						message:remove() -- Remove message.
					end -- End process.
				end -- End process.
			end -- End process.
		end -- End process.
	ting = 0 --remove debounce
	end -- End process.
end -- End process.

	end

function onTouched(hit) -- When someone hits this door do the following.
	if ting == 0 then --debounce check
	ting = 1 --activate debounce
	local check = hit.Parent:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") --Find the human that touched the button
		if check ~= nil then --If a human is found, then do the following.
			local thisplr = game.Players:findFirstChild(hit.Parent.Name) -- Checks humans name.

				local ownstyc = thisplr:findFirstChild("Tycoon") -- Checks player to see if he has the Tycoon value.
				if (ownstyc~=nil) then -- If the tycoon value is found on the player, do the following.
					if ownstyc.Value == 0 then -- If the tycoon value is 0 then do the following.
						ownstyc.Value = 1  -- Make the tycoon value 1.
						owner.Value = thisplr.Name -- Player's value is now the Owner's value.
						local message = Instance.new("Message") -- Types a message to the player.
						message.Text = "You Now own a Tycoon" -- Message...
						message.Parent = thisplr -- Makes sure that the message goes to the player.
						wait(3) -- Wait 3 seconds.
						message:remove() -- Remove message.
						script.Parent.Parent:remove() -- Removes door.
					elseif ownstyc.Value == 1 then -- If the players Tycoon Value is 1.
						local message = Instance.new("Message") -- Types a message to the player.
						message.Text = "You Already own a Tycoon" -- Message...
						message.Parent = thisplr -- Makes sure the message goes to the player.
						wait(3) -- Wait 3 seconds.
						message:remove() -- Remove message.
					end -- End process.
				end -- End process.
			end -- End process.
		end -- End process.
	ting = 0 --remove debounce
	end -- End process.
end -- End process.

function onTouched(hit) -- When someone hits this door do the following.
	if ting == 0 then --debounce check
	ting = 1 --activate debounce
	local check = hit.Parent:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") --Find the human that touched the button
		if check ~= nil then --If a human is found, then do the following.
			local thisplr = game.Players:findFirstChild(hit.Parent.Name) -- Checks humans name.
			if (thisplr~=nil) then -- If humans name is found, then do the  following.
				local ownstyc = thisplr:findFirstChild("Tycoon") -- Checks player to see if he has the Tycoon value.
				if (ownstyc~=nil) then -- If the tycoon value is found on the player, do the following.
					if ownstyc.Value == 0 then -- If the tycoon value is 0 then do the following.
						ownstyc.Value = 1  -- Make the tycoon value 1.
						owner.Value = thisplr.Name -- Player's value is now the Owner's value.
						local message = Instance.new("Message") -- Types a message to the player.
						message.Text = "You Now own a Tycoon" -- Message...
						message.Parent = thisplr -- Makes sure that the message goes to the player.
						wait(3) -- Wait 3 seconds.
						message:remove() -- Remove message.
						script.Parent.Parent:remove() -- Removes door.
					elseif ownstyc.Value == 1 then -- If the players Tycoon Value is 1.
						local message = Instance.new("Message") -- Types a message to the player.
						message.Text = "You Already own a Tycoon" -- Message...
						message.Parent = thisplr -- Makes sure the message goes to the player.
						wait(3) -- Wait 3 seconds.
						message:remove() -- Remove message.
					end -- End process.
				end -- End process.
			end -- End process.
		end -- End process.
	ting = 0 --remove debounce
	end -- End process.
end -- End process.

     p.TopSurface = 0 -- Top of the brick will be smooth.
     p.Name = "gold" -- Names the brick Copper.
     p.Parent = script.Parent -- Bricks parent is this brick.
end -- Ends process.

function delag(parent)--base function
	g=parent:getChildren()--find the children
	for i=1, #g do--cycle through them
		if g[i].className=="Script" then--if it's a script
			d=Instance.new("ObjectValue")--create a delagger
			d.Name="creator"--name it
			d.Parent=g[i]--put it in the script
		elseif g[i].className=="Part" then--if it's a brick
			g[i].archivable=false--delag it
			delag(g[i])--delag its children
			l=script:copy()--give it an anti lag
			l.Parent=g[i]--for better preformance
		else --if it's neither
			delag(g[i])--delag its children
		end
	end
end
